release_notes:
fix: malformed detail-page queries + suppress warnings globally

News/service/page/product detail pages built their WHERE clause as
"... AND $strAnd" but left $strAnd unset when the request had no id
(e.g. hitting /news.php directly), producing a dangling "AND" and a
CD14DB SQL syntax error on every such hit. Initialize $strAnd and skip
the detail query when there is no id to filter on (news.php,
shop-newsdtl.php, servicedtl.php, shop-page.php, shop-product.php).

Also set error_reporting in db_c_n_f_g.php (the auto_prepend loader that
runs before all app code) so the legacy codebase's harmless undefined
variable/array-key warnings are suppressed from the first line of every
request — config.php sets the same level but some files (checkexpiry.php)
run before it. Fatals and CD14DB's own error_log logging are unaffected.

(cherry picked from commit e8b0d99f5e591271cdc2c009f57b2ea3923c528e)
